chunks: It is this notion you had of your Lord that caused your ruin, and you are lost.

key_terms.الْخَاسِرِينَ: The losers (those who lose out in the Hereafter)

ai.seo_question: What does 'zann' (conjecture) mean in the context of divine judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *zann* (speculative belief) that leads to spiritual ruin, particularly when it manifests as arrogance or false certainty about God's mercy or justice. It underscores the principle that one's internal perception of the Divine shapes their reality, warning against those who assume God's leniency without corresponding righteous action. This serves as a critical theological lesson on the alignment of belief (*iman*) with practice (*amal*).
